function.name: speech
function.description: Converts text to a Russian voice message and sends it to the teacher in Telegram. Use only when the teacher explicitly asks for a voice or audio response.

text.description: Text to synthesize and send as a voice message.

instructions.description: Delivery direction for THIS phrase only: tone, pace, emotion, emphasis, pauses. Examples: 'playful teasing with a light smirk', 'pouty and offended, slightly faster', 'genuinely excited, bright and quick', 'soft warm concern, slower', 'deadpan and savage, flat delivery'. Maximum 150 characters. Never repeat the text or the base persona here; add only what differs from it. Omit when the default delivery already fits.
